statusHistory.note: War-room slate pin #2, PLINIO byline. Verified operating: official site lists September 2026 productions by name and date (Wiesenthal 1-5 Sep, The Elixir of Love 8-19 Sep, Private Peaceful 21-23 Sep) and states ~300 performances/yr. History from Wikipedia, which is well-cited on this building: 1859 Jacob Maggs hall built BEHIND the Graces Alley houses (frontage was expensive), 1877 fire and rebuild, Methodist East End Mission ownership 1878-1956 incl. the 1889 Great Dock Strike soup kitchen at the Mahogany Bar, near-demolition in slum clearance, saved by the Betjeman/Sellers/Milligan campaign, Grade II* April 1971, GLC purchase, Trust ownership 2004, £3.6M restoration completed September 2015. 'Oldest grand music hall in the world' is the venue's own claim, attributed as such in the article rather than asserted independently.
